texts: bad: "day 0 of Year 1" lands in the calendar day-of-month slot as (Day 0), which is a different — and impossible — date claim; there is no encoding for an ordinal day within a year. The opening date frame also reaches only this sentence, so every later sentence of the episode ends up undated. Since day 0 is the equinox day itself here, let the anchor carry it: "In Year 1, the night of the autumn equinox was clear and mild." — and repeat the year or the equinox anchor in any later sentence that needs dating.
good. it becomes a rule that actually fires — every lantern of the Cliff Path gets the count — and "about twenty-five" is kept as a hedged value rather than a flat 25, with the "each" recorded.
good. the crowd is one group whose members are nightmoths, gathering at the East Row, with East Row typed and named, so later sentences can refer back to that crowd.
good. the three sky-cats become a counted group descending from the cliff-spires, plus a rule that fires for any individual sky-cat named later so it inherits its own descent.

mixed: the hunt, the cat group, the place and the per-cat distribution are right, but the prey is filed as something the hunt physically changes (Patient) rather than as an unchanged object (Theme) — a translator-side role slip your wording cannot fix. Separately, the bare plural "nightmoths" mints a fresh moth group unconnected to the crowd of sentence 3, so nothing ties the hunt to the crowd that then shrank; making the prey definite fixes that: "The three sky-cats hunted the nightmoth crowd at the East Row."
good. "the nightmoth crowd at the East Row" resolves back to the crowd introduced earlier, and the shrinking is recorded on that same crowd as something it undergoes.

bad: the count and its time never meet. The value seven is recorded as a flat measure of the East Row with no time on it, while "at the third watch" is hung on a separate count entity that also wrongly carries a past tense and a state-holder role — heads only an event may take — so "seven at the third watch" is stated nowhere; a measured value has no time slot to hang the third watch on. Recast it as an ordinary clause whose event can carry both the number and the time: "At the third watch, the East Row held seven nightmoths."

good. it becomes a rule that can fire: any nightmoth that survived that hunt flees to the Hollows, with "the hunt" pointing back at the hunt event of sentence 5, the Hollows treated as a name, and "each" recorded.
